incidents.name: SquidMulticall run() drains user approvals
incidents.notes: SquidMulticall.run() executes an arbitrary Default call supplied by the caller, so the attacker targeted the Binance-Peg ETH token and used the multicall's standing approvals to transferFrom 1 ETH out of a user.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0xad6cea45f98444a922a2b4fe96b8c90f0862d2f4 created 2024-10-01T02:14:47Z by 0xb5e6c16cb726bb24075075e0993971aa8d73f764, which is not the attack-tx sender 0xe02b595ca69d8d3e120043536e6e76caea385a82; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain). 1 ETH x $2129.741200 at the incident timestamp 1775554900 (DefiLlama coingecko:ethereum) = $2,130. The Twitter report notes about $800K of cross-chain approvals were at risk and about $512K was later rescued; this row is scoped to the exploit transaction.
